title: Web client: JMAP session bootstrap
description:
Implement JMAP session bootstrap in app.js: fetch /.well-known/jmap and store the session URLs and accountId.

What: On page load, GET /.well-known/jmap, parse Session object, store apiUrl/eventsUrl/accountId in module state.

Algorithm:
1. In /home/mark/WORK/KITH/web/app.js, module-level state:
   let session = { apiUrl: null, eventsUrl: null, accountId: 'a-self' };
2. async function bootstrap():
   - const resp = await fetch('/.well-known/jmap');
   - if (!resp.ok) throw new Error('Session fetch failed: ' + resp.status);
   - const data = await resp.json();
   - session.apiUrl = data.apiUrl;  // e.g., 'https://host/jmap/api'
   - session.eventsUrl = data.eventSourceUrl;  // template with {types},{closeafter},{ping}
   - session.accountId = 'a-self';  // always; also in data.primaryAccounts['urn:kith:chat:1']
   - session.username = data.username;
   - session.state = data.state;  // opaque combined state token
   - return session;
3. Error handling: catch network errors (tailscaled not running, wrong device), show #error-banner with message 'Cannot connect to Kith. Is Tailscale running on this device?'
4. async function callJmap(methodCalls): wraps POST to session.apiUrl:
   - body: JSON.stringify({ using: ['urn:ietf:params:jmap:core','urn:kith:chat:1'], methodCalls })
   - headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
   - returns: data.methodResponses array
   - throws on HTTP error or method-level error (type in first response entry)
5. document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => bootstrap().then(renderApp).catch(showError));

Defensive programming rules:
- Never access data fields without checking resp.ok first.
- Never eval() any response content.
- Use try/catch around all fetches; show user-visible error on failure.
- eventSourceUrl is a template — replace {types},{closeafter},{ping} before using.

Tests (independent oracle: manually construct expected session shape from RFC 8620 §2):
- After bootstrap(), session.apiUrl ends with '/jmap/api'
- After bootstrap(), session.accountId === 'a-self'
- On fetch failure (mock network down), error banner becomes visible
